يحتشوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَشُوا (yaḥtašū) /jaħ.ta.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# يُحْتَشَوْا (yuḥtašaw) /juħ.ta.ʃaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
